scripts.docs:db: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Error: pnpm docs:db requires the Go toolchain (used to install tbls via "go install"). Install Go from https://go.dev/doc/install, ensure it is on PATH, then re-run pnpm docs:db.' >&2; exit 1; } && GOBIN=$HOME/go/bin go install github.com/k1LoW/tbls@latest && PATH=$HOME/go/bin:$PATH mkdir -p /tmp/brandblitz-tbls-docs && rm -rf /tmp/brandblitz-tbls-docs && PATH=$HOME/go/bin:$PATH tbls doc "${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://brandblitz:brandblitz_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/brandblitz?sslmode=disable}" /tmp/brandblitz-tbls-docs --er-format svg --force && mkdir -p docs/db && cp /tmp/brandblitz-tbls-docs/schema.svg docs/db/er.svg
